smic_2026_monthly.note: Salaire Minimum Interprofessionnel de Croissance, 35h/week basis. Two revaluations occurred in 2026: 1 Jan 2026 (€1,823.03, +1.18%) and 1 June 2026 (€1,867.02, +2.41%, triggered by inflation exceeding the automatic 2% mid-year revaluation threshold). This is the CURRENT figure as of verification. SMIC can revalue mid-year whenever consumer prices for the lowest-income 20% rise 2%+ since the last revaluation — a genuinely more volatile update pattern than most other countries in this dataset, worth flagging for more frequent re-verification than the standard annual-January assumption used elsewhere.

talent_salarie_qualifie_reference_2026.note: The reference salary for Passeport Talent 'salarié qualifié' and the base for the EU Blue Card's 1.5x multiplier. GENUINE STRUCTURAL FINDING: this figure is NOT automatically indexed to SMIC — it is fixed by ministerial arrêté (currently the Arrêté du 21 août 2025) and stays fixed until a new arrêté is published, a materially different update mechanism from every SMIC-linked or IPREM-linked threshold elsewhere in this dataset. Multiple tier-3 sites incorrectly describe it as '1.5x SMIC' (a formula that was true under the prior 2016 arrêté regime but is no longer how the current figure is set) — this is a genuine methodology-level staleness case, not just a stale number, the first of its kind in this dataset.
